title: Fraction presentation of localized tensor-power sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$. Put $A=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $B_n=\Gamma(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ for $n\geq0$. The section-fraction presentation is the $A$-module $Q=(\bigoplus_{n\geq0}B_n)/K$, where $K$ is the $A$-submodule generated by $\iota_n(t)-\iota_{n+b}(t\otimes s^b)$ for $n,b\geq0$ and $t\in B_n$, using the canonical tensor-power associativity identifications. The class of $\iota_n(t)$ denotes $t/s^n$. Addition and scalar multiplication are induced from the direct sum. This presents the degree-zero fractions in the localization of the integer-graded tensor-power section module at $s$; negative powers of $\mathcal L$ are powers of its dual, but a degree-zero numerator over $s^n$ has degree $n\geq0$.
